book.name: Aposel
book.title: APOSEL Aposel wagle kongun erikwa kamo

content: Pita kongun ormere Jerusalem suna ka boglo kugl tongwa
Aposel wagle ya pirngi dingwa yomba Judia kamun koglkoglo meglkwa ye pirkwa Yomba Bina ombugl God kamo pir ime dingwa.
Ana pirkwa okuwo Pita ende imbo Jerusalem ongwa enge, Juda yomba nangino punduno bogltre pirngi dingwa ye eremogl Pita nangiye ka-si,
yegl diteingwa, “Yomba Bina nangino punduno ta boglkrikwa ye yunguno mina ene sraglpre pindre ana ye bogl kaiya mokna ne-ne?”
Dingwa ipre Pita mina komnaiye taragl prapra plau dungwa ikra ka boglo kugl dipene ende tongwa:

“Na Jopa siti suna kamange eremoglko ana taragl ongumutna-mugl yegl orko kaninga. Taragl ta gagl alap kande mereyegl punduno 4 tonguma si gidi i-suwara ende pandigl endingo ana kamun mitna ende atne wu na moglmara ungwa.
Ana gagl alap i mina na kan suna ende kaninga ana makandle dua-kambu onguno katno 4 pangwa ya bugla kande kanekane ya toki kanekane ya te kua are kanekane suna meglkwa.
Ana okuwo ka yegl dinarko na pirka, ‘Pita, ene andigltre taragl i prapra sigogl no!’
“Ba na di ikine endinga, ‘Yaglkande! Kaima yene, na taragl mawagl dinarikwa ya te lo mane dungwa i ta nekrika.’
“Ana aglke kordagl heven imbo ka yegl ta dungwa, ‘God taragl wakai yome dungwa i ene ta deglmbi yeme dikro!’
Sragl i enge suwota plau dungo ana okuwo taragl i prapra gundo yend ikine imbo heven ongwa.
“Ana enge suwara igle keunde, yagl suwota Sisaria kamun meglkwa diendingo ye wu na moglmara yungu igle plau dingwa.
Ana God Spiritmo yegl di narkwa, ‘Ene ye bogl enatnga i noman suwo yeikro.’ Ana pirngi dingwa yomba 6 ye Jopa kamun meglkwa ana na bogl akiye ende Sisaria kamun pindre ana Konilias yungumugl omga.

Ana Konilias ka yegl boglo kugl no norkwa, ‘Na yungunamugl angelo ta unongugl pindre yegl di narkwa, “Ene yomba ta diendimin ye ende Jopa kamun pi yagl ta Saimon, kangiye ta Pita we dingwa, ditenan ye unambuka.”
Ana ye ka ta yundre ene ditenan ana kamo i mina God eremogl ene ya te yungun mina yomba meglkwa i prapra akepledi ere-inambuka.’
“Ana na mambuno ere ka dinga enge Holi Spirit ende atne ye mina ungwa, i okuna nono mina umere yeglkra ungwa.
Ana Yaglkande ka yegl dungwa ikra na poglodi pirka, ‘Jon nigl mina yomba baptais eretongwa, ba ene Holi Spirit mina baptais eraglkwa.’

Ana nono Yaglkandeno Yesus wedi pirngi dumga pre God eremogl Holi Spirit yoko nono normere kuno yegl Yomba Bina ombugl Yesus Krais pirngi dingwa pre tongwa. Na sragl yomba moglmbo ana God sragl orkwa i manedi tenagle?”
Pita ka i ditongo ye pirtre ana ye pre nangiye ka-singwa ikra kindekondo God dembiye sitendre dingwa, “God eremogl Yomba Bina ombugl nomano yakete aimande kor-moraglkwa pre enge ta tongwa.”
Antiok yomba kamambuno pirngi dingwa

Ana Stiven sigeglkwa enge yumbun pond plau dungo ana pirngi dingwa yomba undupagl ere teke ende eglke imbo Ponisia ya Saiprus ya te Antiok pindre ana Juda yomba keunde meglmara ye ka mambuno diteingwa.
Ana pirngi dingwa yagl tau ye Sairini ya Saiprus makan nem ende Antiok kamun pi ana Yaglkande Yesus pre kamo boglo wakai ombugl di Grik yomba teingwa.
Ana Yaglkande yombuglomo ye mina pango ana yomba merkinde kaima pirngi dindre nomano yakete ana ende Yaglkande mina wingwa.
Ana yegl erikwa i kamo boglo waidi ongo God yombama Jerusalem meglkwa pirtre ana ye Barnabas di Antiok kamun endingwa.
Ye pi plau dindre ana God wakaimo yomba tongwa i kandre ye gun yongwa, te ye prapra nomano mundu Yaglkande mina kaima sidakagl moraglmedi pre ka di akekun eretongwa.
Barnabas yagl wakai moglko ana Holi Spirit ye mina mogl kau sungo pirngi dindre ana yomba merkinde kaima iyu Yaglkande mina endungwa.
Ana Barnabas eremogl Sol kan inagledi pre ende Tarsus kamun ongwa.

Ye pi Sol kan indre ana auro yungo ende Antiok embrika. Ana Barnabas ya Sol buglayungu suwarata mundu ye God yombama bogl akiye wanmogl ana yomba merkinde kaima Yaglkande kamo beke tembrika. Ana Antiok kamun igle Krais disaipelma kangino kor Kristen we dingwa.
Enge igle mina propet tau Jerusalem mogltre ana ende atne Antiok kamun eingwa.

Propet eingwa i mina suwarata kangiye Agabas we dingwa, ye anduglko ana Holi Spirit akeple dungo ye yegl dungwa, “Okuwo kindan kandekinde makan koglkoglo yenambuka.” (Ana Klodias Rom kamun king moglkwa enge taragl i plau dungwa.)
Ana disaipel wagle ka dikogl minge moni ya taragl tau ye paitomere imakai sindre ana ye yene angro wagle Judia kamun meglkwa akepledi tenamne dingwa.
Ana moni makai singwa ikra Barnabas ya Sol teingo ye ipi God yombama ende okuna eingwa yomba tembrika.
